items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Yeah, they were Steve Lewis and Walter Pichon. They was about the best they had.

ctx.x: Did they use piano much when you were a kid in the band?
Yeah, they were Steve Lewis and Walter Pichon. They was about the best they had. And Faith Marvin, they were the most recognized piano players.
Well, who was the best for playing ear music? Ear music?
